scope: 23 local font CSSOM cases at 1x on owned Wayland Agent Screen, 17 selected semantic observations for native comparison and six explicit reference-feature gaps. No font loading/matching/shaping/layout/rasterization or website evidence.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

rows.name: width-alias-order
rows.scope: Only final legacy font-stretch=125% is compared. Reference ignores the intervening font-width declaration; this is not Chrome evidence for alias identity.

reference_feature_gaps.name: family-case
reference_feature_gaps.reason: Reference preserves UI-Serif case and collapses quoted/unquoted output, suggesting named-family handling; native current-spec generic identity differs. Kept as a gap, not counted passed.
